record.question: Which one is not correct? Immovable property does not include
record.explanation: Under the General Clauses Act 1897 (s.3(26)), immovable property excludes only standing timber, growing crops and grass. Timber trees are not in that exclusion, so the statement that immovable property does not include timber trees is the incorrect one, option (b). The overlap between 'standing timber' and 'timber trees' makes this mildly ambiguous.
